angle.hook: a cartoon five against five football game with a price in dirhams on Steam, a ten percent pre-purchase discount and a Game Pass listing
angle.why_now: the Steam store page for the UAE shows the ten percent pre-purchase offer ending on 3 December, the release day, and Pure Xbox listed the game among the confirmed Game Pass titles for December on 14 November; the Reel reports the page's current price and offer, nothing older as new
angle.what_it_means_here: a player in the Emirates sees 109.99 dirhams on the Steam store, 98.99 with the ten percent pre-purchase promotion that ends on release day, can wait for Game Pass instead, and should know the Steam language list does not include Arabic (said in the caption and the X text)
angle.payoff: the closing line: the game is out on 3 December and coming to Game Pass too
